comments.body: I worked two days a week (16 hours) for a company in Bern, fully remotely during the first semester of my bachelor's degree. During the summer and the second quarter of 2022, I worked two different jobs at 60% (24 hours). Pay-wise, you could expect between 2 to 2.6k CHF (I had exactly one year of work experience at that time). You don't need to be a German speaker; all of the jobs mentioned above used English as the primary language of communication, even though colleagues liked to speak in Swiss-German among themselves.
comments.author: f00ld
